name: geometric nonlinearity
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 因位形或大变形变化导致力学关系非线性的性质。
usage_overview: 在车辆—曲线轨道动力分析中，用于考虑结构变形引起的几何关系和刚度变化，使钢轨等结构的力学描述反映其变形状态的影响。

complete_examples.text: In this model, Timensheko beam is introduced to model the rail, but its geometric nonlinearity is ignored.
Apart from the geometric nonlinearity of curved tracks, another feature of ballasted tracks is the nonlinear resistance of track bed.
To provide a solution for the aforementioned problems, a vehicle–curved track dynamic interaction model will be presented in which the geometric nonlinearity of curved beam is considered.
The geometric nonlinearity of curved beam is considered in detail.
